note: `debrief` runs only when messages arrived while the session was working. Its load-bearing output is `unanswered`: a question can arrive mid-session, be noticed by the supervisor, and then be lost when the session finishes the task it was already committed to. Nothing else in the system would ever notice. The negative cases matter as much — an invented omission is read by the next session and acted on, so remarks, thanks, and things the reply already covered must come back empty.

cases.note: The clear case. A second person asks something unrelated to the running task, the session carries on and answers the original question, and nobody ever answers theirs.
